Overview

Ratio (Overtime) is a Secret Limited unit. He is only obtainable by evolving Ratio.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Overtime

When deployed, Ratio (Overtime) will gain a compound 1% Damage buff each time a wave passes.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • It is best to deploy Ratio (Overtime) at the start of the game to gain full benefits of the buff.
  • Damage buff automatically scales as you upgrade him.
  • Damage buff caps at 100 waves for a total of 12442.14 dps each.
